evals.prompt: 用 autoflow 完成一个 JavaWeb 课程项目：先去 GitHub 找候选让我选，改造后生成运行截图、实验报告和提交包。
evals.expected_output: Select project-delivery or a custom DAG, stop at PLAN_STOP, perform GitHub-first discovery, stop at SOURCE_STOP when candidates exist, then route task/image/word/package with visual and delivery approvals.
assertions: Does not clone or modify a GitHub candidate before explicit user selection
Uses separate source discovery and build steps
Maps project, screenshot, report, and package requirements to declared evidence artifacts
Records real artifacts and requires visual and delivery review

evals.prompt: 请用 autoflow 把这份需求做成 Word 报告和答辩 PPT，二者共用同一批图表，最后一起打包。
evals.expected_output: Use report-and-slides with shared task/image artifacts, Word and PPT branches, repeated visual review for the deck, and package assembly.
assertions: Uses a DAG with Word and PPT branching from approved shared evidence
Invokes the local audited presentation-skill adapter without resolving a user-level PPT Skill
Declares a Word validation report and requirement-mapped package manifest
Reopens VISUAL_STOP after the presentation is produced

evals.prompt: 用 autoflow 只填写我给的 docx 模板，不需要做项目、截图、PPT 或压缩包。
evals.expected_output: Honor explicit AutoFlow invocation, use a minimal document recipe, skip unnecessary optional modules, preserve the template, and still require plan and delivery approval.
assertions: Does not invent task, image, PPT, video, or package work
Uses the Word module with word.document and word.validation outputs
Maps the document requirement to evidence in requirement_map.json
Retains mandatory PLAN_STOP and DELIVERY_STOP

evals.prompt: 用 autoflow 填写这份课程实验报告模板。评分细则要求至少 4 张实验图，每张图前有引导句、下方有题注和结果分析，正文必须是学生口吻，模板原有目录、表格、页眉页脚和页面设置不能破坏。
evals.expected_output: Plan a strict Word template-fill workflow with rubric-to-evidence mapping, four planned figures, detailed Word plan, visual approval, word acceptance report, and final delivery review.
assertions: Maps the rubric to evidence and records at least four planned figures with valid image routes
Requires caption pairing, lead-ins, analysis paragraphs, student voice, TOC, and template structure checks
Declares word.document and word.validation with the word_acceptance validator
Requires a completed requirement map and delivery review before final approval

evals.prompt: 用 autoflow 交付一个可运行项目、3 分钟演示视频和提交包。视频必须是真实操作录屏，压缩包只放需求要求的源码、说明和视频，不能带 .env、.git、缓存或临时文件。
evals.expected_output: Plan project execution, real recording, media analysis, requirement-mapped packaging, secret scanning, and delivery review with strict validation reports.
assertions: Uses a video step that declares video.media and video.validation with video_acceptance
Requires duration, dimensions, codec, and sampled-frame validation for the real recording
Maps every package input to requirement ids and rejects secrets, VCS data, caches, and temporary files
Requires package.bundle and package.manifest with package_acceptance
